original_threshold_record.note: Strict drying-end criterion: maximum cell liquid-water moles divided by that same cell liquid-water inventory at simulation t=0. This dimensionless fraction is not dry-basis or wet-basis moisture and excludes pore vapor and mineral-bound hydrogen. The equivalent dry-basis limit equals this value times material.water_dry_ratio. The drying-stage ledger starts at the drying_ramp endpoint; conditional_equilibrium.n_eq_over_n0 instead uses the current drying-end cell water as its denominator. These three time references must not be interchanged.

coarse.definition: Max over cells of final liquid-water moles / same-cell original declared liquid-water inventory; not dry or wet basis, excludes pore vapor/mineral-bound H.
